comparisons.name: textedit-light
comparisons.description: The font size control of TextEdit's format bar, Aqua, whole crop: the small size, 43 x 15 pt of fill.

comparisons.name: textedit-light-drawing
comparisons.description: As textedit-light with the text masked, to score the drawing alone: text is set in the fallback font off Apple platforms.

comparisons.name: textedit-dark

comparisons.name: textedit-dark-drawing
comparisons.description: As textedit-dark with the text masked, to score the drawing alone.

comparisons.name: print-sheet-light
comparisons.description: The same control while TextEdit shows its Print sheet, so in a window that is main and not key, Aqua, whole crop: drawn as in the key window.

comparisons.name: print-sheet-light-drawing
comparisons.description: As print-sheet-light with the text masked, to score the drawing alone.

comparisons.name: print-sheet-dark
comparisons.description: The same control while TextEdit shows its Print sheet, Dark Aqua, whole crop.

comparisons.name: print-sheet-dark-drawing
comparisons.description: As print-sheet-dark with the text masked, to score the drawing alone.

comparisons.name: states-light
comparisons.description: The regular size at rest, with the button pressed and disabled, Aqua: the states no screenshot shows, held to the tokens.

pixels.note: fill at mid-height (spec: toolbar-combo-box, Fill, measured #f6f6f6 on the small size)
divider, black at 10% over the fill, 18 pt before the trailing edge (spec: Divider, measured #dddede)
chevron, inside its left arm: black at 65% over the fill (spec: Chevron, measured #565656)
pressed button: the toolbar button's pressed fill at mid-height (measured on Safari's Share button), which the spec infers for this control
the field beside a pressed button keeps the resting fill
disabled chevron: the toolbar button's disabled ink, black at 31% over the fill (inferred)

comparisons.name: states-dark
comparisons.description: The regular size at rest, with the button pressed and disabled, Dark Aqua.

pixels.note: fill, white at 25.1% over the bar's #3a3d3f (spec: Fill, measured #6b6d6f)
divider, black at 10% over the fill (spec: Divider, measured #606163)
chevron, inside its left arm: white at 85% over the fill (spec: Chevron, measured #e9e8e9)
pressed button: the toolbar button's pressed fill, white at about 36%, over the resting fill (inferred for this control)
